beanstalks|AA K S.reading: B IY1 N S T AA2 K S
beanstalks|AA K S.why: Plural of beanstalk, a real word whose last stressed vowel is AA2 followed by K S, the same key as smallpox.

smocked|AA K T.why: Past tense of smock, a real verb used in needlework, and it ends in AA K T like shellshocked.

pawl|AA L.why: A pawl is a real word (the ratchet catch), and in merged General American it is the same as wall.

blotter|AA P ER.why: Its key is AA T ER, not AA P ER, so it does not rhyme with grasshopper.

asthmatic|AA T IH K.reading: AE0 Z M AE1 T IH0 K
asthmatic|AA T IH K.why: The stressed vowel is AE (as in mat), not AA, so the key is AE T IH K.

democratic|AA T IH K.reading: D EH2 M AH0 K R AE1 T IH0 K
democratic|AA T IH K.why: The stress falls on AE (as in crat), so the key is AE T IH K, not AA T IH K.

dogmatic|AA T IH K.reading: D AA0 G M AE1 T IH0 K
dogmatic|AA T IH K.why: The stress falls on AE (as in mat), so the key is AE T IH K, not AA T IH K.

doormug|AH G.why: It is just door and mug run together, with no dictionary entry.

rusty|AH S T.why: It has an extra final syllable (IY) after the AH S T sounds, so its key is AH S T IY, not AH S T.

trusty|AH S T.reading: T R AH1 S T IY0
trusty|AH S T.why: Its key is AH S T IY, which has an extra final syllable and doesn't match AH S T.

results|AH T S.reading: R IH0 Z AH1 L T S
results|AH T S.why: It has an L before the T S, so its key is AH L T S, not AH T S.

sawed|AO R D.why: It has no R, so its key is AO D, not AO R D.

unbored|AO R D.reading: AH1 N B AO2 R D
unbored|AO R D.why: The compound un+bored keeps secondary stress on AO and ends in AO R D, like landlord.

sacramental|EH N T AH L.reading: S AE2 K R AH0 M EH1 N T AH0 L
sacramental|EH N T AH L.why: Its main stress is on -MEN-, so it ends in EH N T AH L, the same as sentimental.

theft|EH P T.why: Its key is EH F T, not EH P T.

gothic|IH K.why: Its final syllable is IH K, matching the key, but the stress falls on the first syllable.

heartsick|IH K.reading: HH AA1 R T S IH2 K
heartsick|IH K.why: Compound with secondary stress on -sick, so it ends in the stressed IH K, like homesick.

heretic|IH K.reading: HH EH1 R AH0 T IH0 K
heretic|IH K.why: The final syllable is IH K, but it is unstressed and the main stress is on the first syllable.

tantric|IH K.reading: T AE1 N T R IH0 K
tantric|IH K.why: The final syllable is IH K, but it is unstressed and the stress is on TAN-.

whin|IH N.why: Whin (gorse) is a real English word, and in General American it is pronounced like win.

ear|IH R D.why: Ear ends in IH R or IY R with no D, so it does not match IH R D.

frontier|IH R D.why: Frontier ends in IH1 R with no final D, so it does not match IH R D.

cherish|IH SH.why: The final syllable is IH SH, but it is unstressed and the stress is on CHER-.

embellish|IH SH.reading: IH0 M B EH1 L IH0 SH
embellish|IH SH.why: The final syllable is IH SH, but it is unstressed and the stress is on -BEL-.

furnish|IH SH.why: Final syllable -nish matches IH SH but is unstressed; stress is on FUR-.

bandleader|IY D ER.reading: B AE1 N D L IY2 D ER0
bandleader|IY D ER.why: Like cheerleader and ringleader, -leader carries secondary stress, so it shares the key IY D ER.

barometer|IY T ER.reading: B ER0 AA1 M AH0 T ER0
barometer|IY T ER.why: Stress is on -rom-, and the final -meter is unstressed, so the key is AA M AH T ER, not IY T ER.

pedometer|IY T ER.reading: P IH0 D AA1 M AH0 T ER0
pedometer|IY T ER.why: Stress is on -dom-, and the final -meter is unstressed, so the key is AA M AH T ER.

askews|UW Z.why: Askew is an adverb or adjective with no plural, so askews is not an English word.

debuts|UW Z.reading: D EY0 B Y UW1 Z
debuts|UW Z.why: Americans commonly say day-BYOOZ with stress on the last syllable, which ends in UW Z.

haiku|UW Z.why: It has no final Z sound, so its key AY K UW is not UW Z.

issues|UW Z.why: The final syllable -sues has the sounds UW Z but is unstressed, with stress on the first syllable.

shrews|UW Z.why: Plural of shrew, a real word pronounced SH R UW1 Z, which ends in the key UW Z.

erosion|UW ZH AH N.reading: IH0 R OW1 ZH AH0 N
erosion|UW ZH AH N.why: Stressed vowel is OW (er-O-sion), not UW, so the key OW ZH AH N does not match UW ZH AH N.

grander|tier.reading: G R AE1 N D ER0
grander|tier.why: Common comparative of 'grand' that rhymes cleanly with commander and a player would plausibly offer it.

norse|tier.why: Norse is a proper adjective/name for a people and language (capitalized), not an ordinary rhyme-hunt word.

crim|tier.why: Only a clipped slang abbreviation of 'criminal' that few players would produce.

jews|tier.why: Capitalized proper-noun ethnonym, not a common rhyme answer, and the lowercase form is also a verb 'jew' that is offensive.
